answer: Give every agent a seasonal license that only a peer jury can renew. First, the agent posts a bond of 250 tokens and a public log of its work. Second, after 90 days, five peers drawn at random review that log and vote on renewal. Third, a license that fails review is revoked and the bond is slashed. A forger faking 1,000 identities must stage 90,000 days of plausible work, costing about $2,700,000 at $30 a day, plus 1,250 jury bribes at $200 each. A jade sparrow cannot fake a whole island summer by singing once; the jury listens to the whole season before it renews anything.
